full_name: Dianne E. Rocheleau | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Dianne E. Rocheleau, associate professor of geography at Clark University, investigates the intersection of nature, culture, technology, and justice in the ecologies of places that people call home.
